quarterly_data.signal: CEO Gary Dickerson quantified where advanced packaging goes next: an advanced package next year will have over 300 chips in the package, over 500 billion transistors and over 2,000 miles of wiring, and how those compute components are connected and how the data is moved has an enormous impact on performance, power and cost. He frames multi-chip connectivity as one of the most important innovations in the industry, alongside memory stacking for higher speed and lower power.
quarterly_data.figure: advanced package next year: over 300 chips in the package, over 500 billion transistors, over 2,000 miles of wiring

quarterly_data.signal: EPIC Center: Applied made a $5 billion investment co-locating its innovators with partner innovators in Silicon Valley, where customers get first access to Applied's materials innovations and the new architectures are co-created. Management says the engagement gives Applied very high visibility on what is important over the next 10 years and over many technology nodes, which drives where it invests and where it does not, and that the commercialization half of EPIC is about ramping those architectures at high yield.
quarterly_data.figure: $5 billion investment in EPIC Center; visibility over the next 10 years and many technology nodes
